items.title: Axis Bank leads India's October credit card rush in its first Apple Pay month - IntelliNews Lambda
items.why: Wallet launches can drive card acquisition in new markets, a useful data point for Apple Pay onboarding conversations.
items.summary_ai: Axis Bank reportedly saw a surge in October credit card activity in India, its first month offering Apple Pay.

items.title: Axis Bank expects MSME loans to rise by 25 pc in H2 of this financial year
